title: Continued authoring architecture

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.

allowedWork: Architecture agenda: measured authoring imports, loading, lifecycle and cost gates across successive outcomes
disallowedWork: Visual redesign, new renderer, semantic scope expansion, unrelated projects
goal: Separate source-only authoring from checked compiler and editor costs, then follow demonstrated bottlenecks
commitCadence: Commit checked packages and push hourly and before handoff
stopConditions: Four-hour ceiling with final quarter reserved; visual judgment, genuine external blocker, user pause or no justified eligible work
